settings.title: Frequently asked questions
settings.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our products and policies.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days within the US. International orders may take 7-14 business days depending on the destination.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 30-day return policy. If you're not satisfied, return your item in original condition for a full refund.

settings.question: Are your products covered by warranty?
settings.answer: Yes, all Luminor products come with a 1-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects.

settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes, we ship to over 40 countries worldwide. Shipping costs are calculated at checkout.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: You'll receive a tracking link via email once your order ships. You can also track it from your account page.

settings.question: Can I change or cancel my order?
settings.answer: Orders can be modified within 2 hours of placing them. Contact us immediately and we'll do our best to help.

settings.title: We're here to help.
settings.text: Our support team is available Monday through Friday, 9am-6pm EST. Reach out and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.
